title: A Hedgehog in a Box
subtitle: 动物与生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物与生态（自然生态·动物与生态）
meta: 主题语境：动物与生态（自然生态·动物与生态）　|　核心词汇：animal　|　正文 372 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 animal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my uncle kept one ① animal, a hedgehog in a box, and my grandfather said an animal in the house is either a pet or a pest and this one was both by turns. The ② wild animals on the hill, meaning foxes and one badger, were counted every year and never came to the same number twice; an animal, my uncle said, is the only thing that knows you and cannot say so.

There was ③ no animal welfare in those years, by which my grandmother meant no word for it, and she said a thing without a word is a thing nobody can be asked about. My father said man is ④ a social animal, and my grandmother said he was the only person she had ever heard prove it by staying in; every animal, she said, is a question we have not learned to ask.

The ⑤ animal instinct she wrote about in 1971, meaning the hedgehog's, was to roll up, and she said rolling up is the only answer anybody has ever been given to everything. The ⑥ animals in the yard, meaning the pigs and not the dog, were five, and he named none of them, and my grandmother said naming is the whole of the difference; an animal, he said, is the only thing you can own without ever owning it.

In 1974 he said there was ⑦ an animal in every man, and my grandmother said there is in some and in others there is nothing at all, which she said was worse. Every ⑧ animal in that room in 1979, meaning the nine men at the table, was waiting for somebody else to speak, and she said the word has never once been used kindly; an animal, she said, is the only word that includes us when it is convenient.

The  animal I would keep, if I kept one, is the hedgehog in the box, which lived five months and which he never mentioned again. An  animal, my father said in 1996, is the only living thing that can be counted, and the only one that has never once been asked whether it wants to be; the animal was in the box for five months and nobody ever counted it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 牲畜；家畜（与宠物相对）
E. 固定搭配：wild / domestic animals 野生／家养动物
F. 固定搭配：animal welfare / rights 动物福利／动物权利
G. 固定搭配：a social animal 社会性动物；群居动物
H. 固定搭配：animal instinct 动物本能

items.q: kept one animal, a hedgehog in a box
The wild animals on the hill
no animal welfare in those years
a social animal, and my grandmother
The animal instinct she wrote about
The animals in the yard, meaning the pigs
there was an animal in every man

answers.why: animal 意为“动物”，1963 年叔叔养过一只动物：盒子里的一只刺猬。
wild animals 意为“野生动物”，山上的野生动物每年清点一次，从来没有两次是同一个数字。
animal welfare 意为“动物福利”，那些年没有动物福利这个说法，祖母的意思是连这个词都没有。
a social animal 意为“社会性动物、群居动物”，父亲说人是社会性动物。
animal instinct 意为“动物本能”，1971 年她写到刺猬的本能是蜷成一团。
animal 意为“牲畜、家畜”，院子里的牲畜指的是那五头猪，而不是那条狗，他一头也没给它们起名。
animal 意为“兽性、动物性”，1974 年他说每个人身上都有兽性。
animal 意为“（某一类的）人、家伙”，1979 年屋里那九个人，也就是桌边每一个“家伙”，都在等别人先开口。
